name: Omoide no Photograph
original_name: 想い出のフォトグラフ
source:
Yuichiro Ino is a photographer who does not sell well. This time he has to take a job of photographer assistant to get the views of Kyoto. He rides the Shinkansen and gets to Kyoto where he meets four beautiful girls.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
伊能雄一郎是一名事业不顺的摄影师。这一次，他不得不接下摄影助理的工作，前往京都拍摄风景。他乘新干线抵达京都，在那里遇见了4名美少女。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vndb-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
